rules.name: Migrations directory present
rules.remediation: Pick the ORM's conventional location (e.g. db/migrate for Rails, alembic/versions for Alembic) and keep all migrations there.

rules.name: Migrations directory is non-empty
rules.remediation: An empty migrations/ directory usually means the schema is hand-managed — switch to versioned migrations.

rules.name: Flyway-style versioned migrations follow V<N>__<name>.sql
rules.remediation: Flyway expects files named V<version>__<description>.sql or R__<repeatable>.sql in src/main/resources/db/migration/.

rules.name: Alembic migrations directory is structured
rules.remediation: Alembic places per-revision migrations in alembic/versions/<rev>_<slug>.py.
